editorial.blurb: Saigon Sisters serves Vietnamese favorites at French Market with inconsistent execution—baos are genuinely delicious and filling, but broth-based dishes and banh mi need refinement.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the baos (pork belly, Vietnamese wagyu, or curry chicken) rather than pho or banh mi; three baos for $10.75 are generously filled and consistently praised, and add the caramelized egg for $1 on the side.
